reviews.title: Too Fast for Seniors but Good Games
reviews.text:
I’m using this for my mom. 
The good: excellent variety of games, very good ways of engaging the senior player without unnecessary things onscreen/in game that would be distracting. Good, clean interface and functionality. Great, instant feedback that shows correction without discouraging the player.
The not so good (deducted 0.5 star): There are no settings to give the senior a longer amount of time to absorb what they need to memorize. As a result,this game is great IF the senior does not already NEED something like this. Also, the items pictured in “grocery list” game are so small they cannot be discerned on a large phone screen (not sure if it would be better on a large iPad, but we don’t have one of those and won’t be getting one.) 
The bad (deducted 1.5 more stars):  I paid for no ads AND paid extra for premium to utilize games beyond the 5 or so free games (was happy to do both). Every time we tap on a “premium” game that was already paid for a popup denies access unless choose button to pay for it (again) or choose button to play for free just once. In settings, the “restore purchase” is always grayed out. Sometimes after tapping it, despite grayed out button and zero indication it recognized the tap, the already paid for “premium” game is accessible when immediately returning to game Home Screen. My big concern: if my mom or anyone who needs help via MEMORY games continually gets popup saying they have to pay, she likely would not remember if she already paid and may well end up paying multiple times. It’s a good thing I can do this with her (and have settings that won’t allow automatic charge because that would have already happened a few (if not several) times. It’s probably just some glitch but it does not read well for a game specifically addressing brain/memory games for the senior demographic. Again, other than these items, the games are helpful and once in the game, the games work well (just need an option to slow it down a little for people who are truly seniors😊).
